metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a standard-library-only Rust Cargo project in [output/Cargo.toml](/workspace/output/Cargo.toml) with the CLI entry point in [output/src/main.rs](/workspace/output/src/main.rs). The tool supports `parse`, `write`, `query`, `eval`, and `roundtrip`, includes fixed-format IGES section parsing/writing, canonical JSON I/O, entity extraction, and parametric evaluation for the contract’s curve/surface set.

`cargo build --release --manifest-path /workspace/output/Cargo.toml` succeeds. I also smoke-tested end to end by writing a minimal Type 110 line from canonical JSON, parsing the emitted IGES back, evaluating it at `t=0.5`, and round-tripping to a byte-identical file.
